feature: A picked layer wears the solid accent ring
summary: What you pick on the canvas is now outlined with one solid line in the accent colour, as every mock draws it, instead of a faint dotted blue line. It stays readable on white, on blue and on dark pictures.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default.

try.do: Open any screenshot and click a layer on it with the Select tool (V).
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Pick a layer that sits on a blue part of the picture.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Pick a layer on a dark part, then switch the Mac to Light appearance and look again.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Shift-click a second layer so two are picked.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Open a screen recording, push it in past the frame with Scale, and click the recording.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Drag a picked layer around and watch the ring follow it.

evaluate: Does the solid ring read as the mocks' ring at a glance?
On a blue screenshot, can you still see exactly where the ring is?
Is the faint light edge round the ring invisible enough on white and quiet enough on dark?
With two layers picked, does the finer ring still say both are picked?
rough: Goes further than the mock: each ring has a faint white halo just wider than the line, because a bare accent line vanishes on a blue screenshot. On white it cannot be seen; on dark it shows as a grey hairline either side.
The finer ring on each of several picked layers reads more grey than blue on a dark picture, where the halo outweighs the 70% line.
A rounded shape's ring still curves with the shape's corners, where the mock hugs the box with a 2px radius: a-picked-rounded-shape-is-ringed-round-its-box-a.
The resize squares and the turn knob are unchanged.
